1. (Currently amended) A method for synchronous triggering of events in multiple modules, each module receiving a serial bit stream over a respective communications link, each said communications link comprising a data out and a clock line, each said clock line derived from a single clock source, the method comprising the steps of: transmitting a send packet over said data out line to each module synchronous with said clock source wherein said send packet contains at least one bit position defined as a trigger bit __that is distinct from data bits in said send packet__ and triggering an event in a respective one of said modules upon receipt of a respective one of said at least one trigger bit, wherein said triggering comprises __galvanically isolated__ event triggering.

2. (Currently amended) A method as recited in claim 1 wherein said triggering an event comprises __synchronous__ waveform digitization __on a first channel of said module__.

3. (Currently amended) A method as recited in claim 1 wherein said triggering an event comprises __synchronous__ waveform synthesis __on a second channel of said module__.

4. (Currently amended) A method as recited in claim 1 said communications link further comprising a data in line and further comprising receiving a serial bit stream over said data in line comprising a receive packet from each said module, wherein a predefined bit in each said receive packet comprises an indication that a measurement is triggered __and said receive packet is transmitted synchronously with said clock source__.

5. (Currently amended) A method as recited in claim 4 wherein said receive packet from each module further comprises a plurality of bits reflecting __synchronous and galvanically isolated__ results of said triggered measurement.

6. (Currently amended) A method as recited in claim 1 wherein said triggering an event comprises generating said trigger event at a data rate that is twice a data rate of said single clock source, thereby generating at least two trigger events during a single period of said single clock source __and wherein said trigger events are embedded within said send packet__.

7. (Currently amended) A method as recited in claim 6 wherein said triggering an event comprises altering a data bit period prior to said trigger event and altering a data bit period after said trigger event __to maintain synchronization with said single clock source__.

8. (Currently amended) A method as recited in claim 1 further comprising generating at least two data bit periods at a data rate that is twice a data rate of said single clock source __wherein said data bit periods and trigger bits are synchronized to said single clock source__.

9. (Currently amended) A method as recited in claim 1 wherein said triggering an event comprises generating said trigger event at a data rate that is twice a data rate of said single clock source, thereby generating at least two trigger events during a single period of said single clock source; and further comprising generating at least two data bit periods at a data rate that is twice a data rate of said single clock source __wherein said trigger events and data bit periods remain synchronized to said single clock source__.

10. (Previously presented) An apparatus as recited in claim 9 wherein said at least two trigger events are interleaved with said at least two data bit periods.

11. (Currently amended) An apparatus for performing synchronous triggering of events in multiple modules comprising a housing comprising a controller and receiving two or more modules, a respective serial communications link between said controller and each of said two or more modules, each said communications link comprising a data out and a clock line, each said clock line derived from a single clock source, means for transmitting a send packet over said data out line to each module synchronous with said clock source wherein said send packet contains at least one bit position defined as a trigger bit __that is distinct from data bits in said send packet__, and means in each said module for triggering a module specific event upon receipt of respective ones of said trigger bits, wherein said triggering comprises __galvanically isolated__ event triggering.

12. (Currently amended) An apparatus as recited in claim 11 wherein one of said events comprises __synchronous__ waveform digitization __on a first channel of said module__.

13. (Currently amended) An apparatus as recited in claim 11 wherein one of said events comprises __synchronous__ waveform digitization __on a first channel of said module__ and __synchronous__ waveform synthesis __on a second channel of said module__.

14. (Currently amended) An apparatus as recited in claim 11 said communications link further comprising a data in line and further comprising means for receiving a serial bit stream over said data in line comprising a receive packet from each said module, wherein a predefined bit in each said receive packet comprises an indication that a measurement is triggered __and said receive packet is transmitted synchronously with said clock source__.

15. (Currently amended) An apparatus as recited in claim 14 wherein said receive packet from each module further comprises a plurality of bits reflecting __synchronous and galvanically isolated__ results of said triggered measurement.

16. (Currently amended) An apparatus as recited in claim 11 wherein one of said events comprises __synchronous__ waveform synthesis __on a second channel of said module__.

17. (Currently amended) An apparatus as recited in claim 11 wherein said trigger bit comprises at least two trigger bits at a data rate that is twice a data rate of said single clock source, thereby generating at least two trigger bits during a single period of said single clock source __and wherein said trigger bits are embedded within said send packet__.

18. (Currently amended) An apparatus as recited in claim 11 further comprising at least one data field, said at least one data field generated at a data rate that is twice a data rate of said single clock source __wherein said data field and trigger bits are synchronized to said single clock source__.

19. (Currently amended) An apparatus as recited in claim 11 wherein said trigger bit comprises at least two trigger bits at a data rate that is twice a data rate of said single clock source, thereby generating at least two trigger bits during a single period of said single clock source; and at least two data fields, said at least two data fields generated at a data rate that is twice a data rate of said single clock source __wherein said trigger bits and data fields remain synchronized to said single clock source__.

20. (Previously presented) An apparatus as recited in claim 19 wherein said at least two trigger bits are interleaved with said at least two data fields.
